name: t0/greedy
why:
MEASURED 2026-08-20 on the six probes that spiral, 2 passes each, budget 8000 (hardtemp_glm47.json), replacing the previous vendor-default entry that was never measured at all. Result: every one of the four configs answered 12/12. t0/greedy 18028 tok; t0.6/k20 20522; t0.8/k20 15272; t1.0/k64 29724.

This model does not spiral. hardtemp.py exists because at temperature 0 a reasoning trace can fail to terminate and burn the whole budget inside <think>, which was measured on the two vLLM models and is why greedy is excluded from its default config list. It is not true here: GLM 4.7 Flash terminated on 12/12 probes at temperature 0, so the premise that motivated a temperature sweep does not apply to it.

With reliability tied at the ceiling there is no reliability argument for leaving greedy, so the choice falls to the two things that remain. First, greedy matches this model's off arm exactly, which makes its off/on delta a genuine single-variable measurement -- the only thing differing between the arms is whether reasoning was suppressed. That is precisely the confound the previous version of this file flagged and could not remove.

Second, the tuner's own auto-pick (max answered, then fewest tokens) selects t0.8/k20 on its 15272, and that is rejected deliberately. Token cost above temperature 0 is one stochastic sample per config, and the ranking here is non-monotonic in temperature -- 20522 at 0.6, 15272 at 0.8, 29724 at 1.0 -- which cannot be a real property of the setting. Greedy's cost is the only one that is reproducible: the sweep was run twice after an unrelated crash, and greedy returned 18028 tokens and 12/12 both times, byte-for-byte. Ranking four configs on one noisy draw each is the same mistake mkprofiles.py's docstring records from the first tuner, which is why this decision lives in a hand-written file rather than being read off the auto-pick.

Consequence for interpretation: unlike the previous vendor-default entry, this model's reasoning arm now carries no sampling confound.
